definitions.explanation: The punctuation marks [ ] used to enclose editorial insertions, phonetic transcriptions, or technical notations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{発音|はつおん}→発音：01698_hatsuon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{角括弧|かくかっこ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{表|あらわ}す→表す：01868_arawasu⟧。
examples.english: Pronunciation is shown in square brackets.

examples.japanese: ⟦{引用|いんよう}→引用：01850_inyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{補足|ほそく}→補足：08386_hosoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{角括弧|かくかっこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Use square brackets when adding supplementary information within a quotation.

examples.japanese: ⟦プログラミング→プログラミング：06099_puroguramingu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{角括弧|かくかっこ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{配列|はいれつ}→配列：14447_hairetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧インデックス⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}われる→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: In programming, square brackets are used for array indices.

notes:
Composed of {角|かく} (angle, corner) + ⟦{括弧|かっこ}→括弧：00151_kakko⟧ (brackets). The standard term for square brackets [ ] in Japanese. Less common in general Japanese writing than ⟦{丸括弧|まるかっこ}→丸括弧：26049_marukakko⟧ (parentheses), but frequently used in academic, technical, and programming contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {角括弧|かくかっこ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{囲|かこ}む→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧: to enclose in square brackets
- {角括弧|かくかっこ}⟦{内|ない}→〜内：09853_nai⟧: inside the square brackets
- {角括弧|かくかっこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧: to add square brackets

USAGE:
- Academic papers: editorial insertions in quotations
- Linguistics: phonetic transcriptions
- Programming: array access, optional parameters
- Dictionaries: supplementary information

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{丸括弧|まるかっこ}→丸括弧：26049_marukakko⟧: parentheses ( ) -- the most common bracket type
- ⟦{中括弧|なかかっこ}→中括弧：26051_nakakakko⟧: curly brackets { } -- used in programming and math
- ⟦{括弧|かっこ}→括弧：00151_kakko⟧: brackets (generic) -- defaults to parentheses in casual use
